moves.name: Ferocious Play Rough
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses any moves 1 time.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by 1 stat rank. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets.

moves.name: Booster Energy
moves.description: Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 1 rank.

moves.name: Our Greatest Battle!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Attack by 6 stat ranks. Raises the user’s Speed by 4 stat ranks.

passives.name: Paldea Pride
passives.description: Powers up the physical attack moves of all allied sync pairs by 20%. Reduces physical attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 25%. The more allied sync pairs with the Paldea theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 15% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 50%, and the maximum damage reduction is 31%.)

passives.name: Ancient Scream
passives.description: Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks when it uses Booster Energy or an ally turns the weather sunny.

passives.name: Energetic Student Council President
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 when its Pokémon uses a status move. Applies Paldea Circle (Physical) to the allied field of play when the user’s Pokémon uses a status move.

passives.name: Fruitful Attack
passives.description: Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with the user’s following attacks become critical hits: Pokémon’s moves or sync move. Charges the user’s move gauge by 1 when its attack move hits.

subPassives.name: P-Moves & S-Moves Crit
subPassives.description: Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with the user’s following attacks become critical hits: Pokémon’s moves or sync move.

subPassives.name: Recharging Strike 9
subPassives.description: Has a chance (100%) of charging the user’s move gauge by one when its attack move hits. If the move has the multistrike effect tag, has a chance (100%) of charging the user’s move gauge by one for each hit.
